versions.changelog:
jf-open-pro-smart-doorlock-control v1.0.0

- Initial release with support for JFTech smart door lock remote control.
- Query if device supports door lock capability.
- Device login and API token acquisition.
- Retrieve device configuration details.
- Remote one-click unlock functionality (password and no-password modes).
- Includes environment variable and API endpoint details for multiple regions.
